notes.title: 🛠️ Update V1.3 – Major fixes and improvements!
notes.notes:
✨ [b]General improvements[/b]

Improved game performance to reduce stuttering and increase smoothness of gameplay.
Improved button responsiveness to ensure a smoother control experience.
Improved graphics quality without affecting performance.

🐔 [b]Bug Fixes[/b]

Fixed an issue that caused the game to freeze when pressing some buttons.
Fixed a bug where the player could not resume the game after pausing.
Fixed an issue where some elements appeared incorrectly in some environments.
Fixed bugs related to sound and sound effects.
Improved game stability and reduced sudden crashes.

⚙️ [b]Gameplay Improvements[/b]

Tweaked some mechanics to make the experience more enjoyable.
Improved the save system for faster and more stable loading.
